ValidationRule.description: Blocks manual changes to Funding Complete Date on IVF Treatment cases unless the user has the finance controls override flag.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "IVFTreatment", OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Funding_Complete_Date__c) ), NOT(ISBLANK(Funding_Complete_Date__c)), OR( AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISCHANGED(FundingCompleteReason__c)) ), Funding_Complete_Date__c <> TODAY() ), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT($User.IVF_Finance_Controls__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only BDSB finance users can change the Funding Complete Date.
